Translate every value into the target language; keep every key, every {0}/{1}/{2} placeholder and every % sign. Do not summarise — a fragment is a stub, not a translation. desc must be <=160 code points (hard fail >170); title <=50; home is NOT changed. Output scripts/tools-i18n/<locale>.json with exactly: search, kw{28}, w{195}, t{9 tools each title/h1/desc/intro/steps[4]/faq[2]{q,a}}. (4) contract-generator must keep the "not legal advice" disclaimer prominent in intro/faq. loan-calculator t prose is unchanged — only its 10 new loan* widget keys and the "mortgage calculator" kw phrase are new.

shoe-size-converter.title: Shoe Size Converter
shoe-size-converter.h1: Shoe size converter — US, EU, UK and CN
shoe-size-converter.desc: Convert shoe sizes between US, EU, UK and CN for men and women. Enter a size or foot length and see every system at once — free and instant.
shoe-size-converter.intro: This converter maps a shoe size or a foot length in centimetres across the US, EU, UK and CN systems, for both men’s and women’s fits. Type a size in any system, or measure your foot heel-to-toe, and it shows the equivalent in all the others plus the foot length in cm and inches. Conversions are approximate retail standards and vary by brand and last.
steps: Choose men’s or women’s fit.
Pick the size system you know (US, EU, UK, CN or cm).
Enter your size or foot length.
Read the equivalent sizes in every system.

faq.q: How do I measure my foot for the right size?
faq.a: Stand on paper in the evening, mark the heel and the longest toe, and measure the distance in centimetres. Enter that length in the cm system; measure both feet and use the larger one.
They are approximate retail standards. Brands and shoe lasts differ, so always check the maker’s own size chart and choose the larger size when you fall between two.

rmb-uppercase.title: RMB Uppercase Converter
rmb-uppercase.h1: Convert an amount to Chinese uppercase RMB
rmb-uppercase.desc: Convert a number to the Chinese uppercase RMB amount used on cheques and invoices. Handles yuan, jiao and fen. Free, instant, no upload.
rmb-uppercase.intro: Type an amount and the converter writes it in the financial Chinese uppercase form (daxie) used on cheques, invoices and contracts to prevent tampering. It handles yuan, jiao and fen, marks an exact whole amount correctly, and works up to just under one trillion. The calculation uses integer cents to avoid floating-point errors.
steps: Enter the amount, for example 1234.56.
The uppercase RMB amount appears instantly.
Check the yuan, jiao and fen parts.
Copy the result for your cheque or invoice.

faq.q: What is the Chinese uppercase amount for?
faq.a: It is the tamper-resistant financial form (daxie) required on cheques, invoices and contracts in China, where ordinary digits could be altered. Each digit has a complex character that is hard to forge.
The first decimal place is jiao and the second is fen. An exact whole amount ends with a character marking “no cents”, so 100 and 100.00 are both written correctly.

world-clock.title: World Clock
world-clock.h1: World clock — time zones and meeting planner
world-clock.desc: See the live time in 12 world cities, compare time zones and plan a meeting across them, with business-hours highlights. Free, no sign-up.
world-clock.intro: The world clock shows the live time in twelve major cities, each with its date and a green dot during local business hours (09:00–18:00). Drag the planner to line up a meeting across time zones and see what time it lands in each city, with a badge when a city is on a different calendar day. Times are shown against your own time zone.
steps: See the live time in twelve world cities.
Note the green business-hours dots and day badges.
Drag the planner to set a meeting time.
Read the local time in each city.

faq.q: Does it account for daylight saving time?
faq.a: Yes. Times are computed with your browser’s time-zone database, so daylight saving transitions are applied automatically for each city.

faq.q: How do I plan a meeting across time zones?
faq.a: Drag the planner slider to a time in your own zone; every city card updates to show its local time, and a badge marks any city that falls on a different day.

pomodoro-timer.title: Pomodoro Timer
pomodoro-timer.desc: A Pomodoro timer for focused work: 25-minute sessions, short and long breaks, a session counter and an optional chime. Free, in-browser.
pomodoro-timer.intro: The Pomodoro technique alternates focused work with short breaks, and a longer break after a few rounds. Set the focus, short-break and long-break lengths, start the timer, and it counts down with a session counter and an optional chime at each phase change. Fullscreen mode keeps a large countdown visible while you work. The timer runs while the tab is open.
steps: Set your focus and break lengths.
Press Start to begin a focus session.
Work until the chime, then take a break.
Repeat; a long break comes after a few rounds.

faq.q: What are the default Pomodoro lengths?
faq.a: The classic cycle is 25 minutes of focus, a 5-minute short break, and a 15-minute long break after four focus sessions. You can change all three lengths and the number of rounds.

faq.q: Does it stay accurate if I switch tabs?
faq.a: The timer counts against the clock rather than decrementing, so it stays accurate even when the browser throttles a background tab. Keep the tab open, or use fullscreen for a large countdown.

random-picker.title: Random Picker
random-picker.desc: Spin a wheel to pick a random name, or draw a winner instantly. Add one name per line, remove winners and pick a whole team. Free, no upload.
random-picker.intro: Type one name per line, spin the wheel, and a winner is chosen with crypto.getRandomValues() so every name has an equal chance. Remove the winner after each draw to pick a whole team in order, or use Quick draw for an instant result without the animation. Reset to start again. Everything runs locally in your browser.
steps: Enter one name per line.
Press Spin the wheel (or Quick draw).
Read the winner.
Remove the winner to draw again, or reset.

faq.a: Yes. It uses the browser’s crypto.getRandomValues(), a cryptographically secure random source, so each name has an equal chance and the result is not predictable.

faq.q: Can I pick several winners without repeats?
faq.a: Yes. Use “Remove winner” after each draw to take that name out of the wheel, so you can pick a whole team in order. Reset restores all the names.

invoice-generator.title: Invoice Generator
invoice-generator.h1: Free invoice generator — create a PDF invoice
invoice-generator.desc: Create a professional invoice in your browser. Add your details, line items, tax and discount, then download a PDF or PNG. Free, no upload.
invoice-generator.intro: Fill in the seller and client details, add line items with quantities and prices, set a discount and tax rate, and the generator lays out a clean invoice with totals. Preview it, then export a one-page PDF or a PNG image. Everything is drawn locally in your browser, so your financial details never leave your device.
steps: Enter your details and the client’s details.
Add line items with quantity and unit price.
Set the currency, discount and tax rate.
Generate, then download the PDF or PNG.

faq.q: Is my invoice data uploaded anywhere?
faq.a: No. The invoice is rendered on a canvas in your browser and exported locally as a PDF or PNG. Nothing is sent to a server, so your figures stay private.

faq.q: Can I use my own currency and tax rate?
faq.a: Yes. Pick from eight currencies and set any discount percentage and tax rate; the subtotal, discount, tax and total are calculated for you.

signature-pad.title: Signature Pad
signature-pad.h1: Draw your signature online — transparent PNG
signature-pad.desc: Draw your signature with a mouse, finger or stylus and download a transparent PNG. Undo, clear and trim empty space. Free, no upload.
signature-pad.intro: Sign on the canvas with a mouse, touch screen or stylus, choose a pen colour and width, and download a PNG with a transparent background so it drops cleanly onto a contract or form. Undo strokes, clear the pad, or trim the empty space around your signature. Nothing is uploaded — the drawing stays in your browser.
steps: Draw your signature on the pad.
Adjust the pen colour and width if needed.
Undo or clear to fix mistakes; trim empty space.
Download the transparent PNG.

faq.a: The PNG is exported with an alpha channel, so only your strokes are opaque. That lets you place the signature over a document without a white box around it.

faq.q: Can I sign on a phone or tablet?
faq.a: Yes. The pad uses pointer events, so a finger or stylus works just like a mouse. Draw, then download the PNG to your device.

id-photo-maker.title: ID Photo Maker
id-photo-maker.h1: Passport and ID photo maker online
id-photo-maker.desc: Make passport, visa and ID photos at home. Crop to the right size, set the dpi, and replace the background with white, blue or red. Free.
id-photo-maker.intro: Upload a portrait, choose a preset (China 1-inch, China 2-inch, passport/visa or US passport) or a custom size in millimetres, and set the print resolution. Zoom and shift to frame the head, then optionally replace a plain background with white, blue or red. The photo is processed locally and downloaded as a JPEG ready to print.
steps: Upload a clear, front-facing portrait.
Pick a size preset or set a custom width and height.
Zoom and adjust the position; optionally replace the background.
Make the photo and download the JPEG.

faq.q: Will this photo be accepted for my passport?
faq.a: It produces a correctly sized, high-resolution photo, but acceptance depends on your issuing authority’s rules for pose, lighting and background. Always check the official requirements before printing.
It keys out the colour in the top-left corner of your photo, so start with a plain, evenly lit backdrop. Adjust the tolerance to remove more or less of the old background.

contract-generator.title: Contract Generator
contract-generator.h1: Free NDA and service agreement generator
contract-generator.desc: Generate a mutual NDA or a service agreement from a simple template. Fill in the parties, purpose and terms, then download or print. Free.

Download it as a text file or print it. The draft is created in your browser and never uploaded. This is a general template, not legal advice — have a qualified lawyer review it before signing.

Enter the parties, date and key terms.
Generate the draft and read it over.
Download the .txt or print it.

faq.q: Is this a legally binding contract?
faq.a: It is a general template to start from, not legal advice. Laws differ by country and situation, so have a qualified lawyer review and adapt it before anyone signs.
The parties, effective date, purpose or scope of services, fee, term and governing law. Delete clauses that do not apply and add the details specific to your deal.
